title: Chat tells an AI what game to make live on stream, looking for people to throw ideas at it
author: Subrising
selftext:
Hey all!

So I had this idea a while back of doing something like Twitch Plays Pokemon but instead of chat playing a game, chat tells an AI what game to make and the stream is just the AI making it live. It's on every night from 6pm Brisbane time, Claude makes each game in Godot from an empty project and there's an AI host called Nova reading chat for ideas, so each night is more like a little community game jam than anything.

Some of it's been pretty funny, one night someone on Twitch asked for a pokemon samurai adventure and it came back with "we cannot borrow famous creatures; our ronin stays original" haha. For a while every single game ended up with a coin magnet in it too no matter what the game was.

Chat's been pretty quiet so far so it's mostly been me and the AI picking stuff, which kind of defeats the point. Would love more people to come in and throw ideas at it and let me know if there's anything I should change.

The games are rough jam results but the newest one is always free in the browser https://chatmakesgames.itch.io/cmg-show-game and the stream is twitch.tv/chatmakesgames

Any ideas would be appreciated!

comments.author: Brettinabox
comments.body: There'd already s channel that does this and it was backed up so I left. Later I tried Claude fort the first time and I wasnt that impressed. Will stick with gemini for now.

comments.author: Subrising
comments.body: Haha fair call on the coin magnet. That's a pretty cool idea tbh, would be interesting to see what it does with the different endings. Chuck it in the chat on stream and Nova should pick it up mate.
